pages.text: Akaishi gear is a $(4)beefed-up Netherite set$(0), roughly x1.25 on the stats sheet:$(li)armor $(4){4,7,10,4}$(0) (boots/legs/chest/head), toughness 4$(li)knockback resistance 0.1, enchantability 15$(li)the sword hits for 11; pickaxe/shovel/axe outclass Netherite the same way$(br2)$(bold)None of it is crafted at a table anymore$(0) — the front door is the Equipment Forger below.

$(bold)Craft it:$(0) every piece of Akaishi gear comes from the $(l:akaishi:equipment_forger)Equipment Forger$(/l) — feed it Netherite gear and Akaishi Ingots, each piece has its own cost.$(br2)$(bold)Enhance it:$(0) after recasting, the $(l:akaishi:upgrade_station)Upgrade Station$(/l) bolts special abilities on, and the ticket is the $(l:akaishi:upgrade_template)Upgrade Template$(/l).$(br2)To farm ingots on autopilot, read $(l:akaishi:ingot)Akaishi Ingot$(/l) first.
The Forger, the Station and the Template are one pipeline: recast, then bolt on abilities, then bolt on more; Akaishi Ingots are the recasting fuel.
